key_explanation.title: Key concepts and formulas from the book

topics.explanation: If a distance is covered at x km/h and the same distance at y km/h, Average Speed = (2xy) / (x + y) km/h.
Sum of first n natural numbers = n(n + 1) / 2. Their average = (n + 1) / 2.
Average of first n even natural numbers = n + 1. Average of first n odd natural numbers = n.
Weighted Average = (w1*x1 + w2*x2 + ... + wn*xn) / (w1 + w2 + ... + wn).

questions.question: In the first 10 overs of a cricket game, the run rate was only 3.2. What should be the run rate in the remaining 40 overs to reach the target of 282 runs?

In a one-day cricket match the captain of one of the teams scored 30 runs more than the average runs scored by the remaining six batsmen of that team who batted in the match. If the total runs scored by all the batsmen of that team were 310, how many runs did the captain score?
